text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT (PD-38921) fired for gpu-node-24: kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall. Affected pods: inference-service(3), redis-cache(1). Possible customer impact in us-east. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-38921

tara_oncall: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling serial logs and node status now.

pagerduty-bot: PD-38921 acknowledged by tara_oncall

alex: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-24 -o wide` shows: `STATUS: NotReady   LASTHEARTBEAT: 2026-03-15T07:11:58Z`. Node kernel messages show OOPS. Trying `kubectl describe node gpu-node-24` for taints.

mike: attaching serial console (via ipmi) - seeing repeated stack traces and GPU firmware errors. snippet:
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=4123, 
[  123.456790] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```
Looks like GPU driver or NVMe causing panic. I can try soft-reboot but we should evacuate pods first.

carmela: notifying CS & SRE leads. Early signs: ~3% of serving capacity in us-east degraded, some requests 500. Customers affected: tenant-acme (elevated error rate). I'll open a customer ticket.

tara_oncall: cordoning node now -> `kubectl cordon gpu-node-24` => node is cordoned.

tara_oncall: starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-node-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` (will monitor pod evictions)

alex: triggering routing fallback for critical tenants to fallback-gpu pool and cpu-fallback for non-GPU workloads. Applied route policy `route: inference-prod -> fallback-gpu`.

mike: drain progress: 3/4 pods evicted, inference-prod shard relocated to gpu-node-11 and cpu-fallback pool. Serial shows continued kernel oops when touching /dev/nvme0.

tara_oncall: drain complete. Node marked unschedulable and eviction finished at 07:15:21Z.

carmela: post-evac metrics: 5xx rate for inference-prod dropped from 4.8% to 0.9% within 3m after fallback. Notifying affected customers that we have mitigated but investigating root cause. No SLA breach currently.

alex: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` to confirm all critical pods are green. Also kicked off a canary to verify quality on fallback-gpu.

mike: preparing RMA. I'll open a hardware ticket and mark node for offboarding. Posting relevant logs to infra ticket: https://internal/infra/ISSUE-987

tara_oncall: escalating to oncall-backup @robin_oncall for overnight monitoring. Handing off at 07:30Z.

robin_oncall: ack, taking the handoff. Summary: PD-38921 kernel panic on gpu-node-24, node drained, workloads relocated, routing fallback applied, customer impact limited, RMA initiated. I'll monitor for re-occurrence and run deeper log collection overnight.

tara_oncall: adding runbook notes: actioned cordon+drain, triggered fallback policy, opened RMA, customer comms sent by carmela. Next steps for robin: collect dmesg + nvme SMART, attempt controlled reboot in maintenance window if safe, otherwise proceed with hardware replacement.

carmela: CS update sent: 'We've mitigated impact by moving workloads; investigating root cause. We'll follow up with more details after hardware analysis.' :email:

alex: leaving one final check: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-node-24` -> `NotReady` still. I'll keep the logs posted.

incident-bot: PD-38921 resolved (manual) - incident thread closed pending RMA followup. If node reboots back into Ready unexpectedly, will re-open.

robin_oncall: thanks, picking this up. I'll post updates here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
